On Wed, Apr 27, 2022 at 3:09 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hello! Yes, it was such a pleasure meeting you all.
Verification. Thank you for sending over. I have passed these along to the team for further review from
here, with the exception of [contact omitted] who needs to quickly add a header photo.
Technical Questions. To your questions raised yesterday:
• Downloading audio file: The download will be in a .ts file format, which you can easily convert into an
audio file like.mp3 or.wav, or even a video. However, there are no transcriptions included.
• Data analysis: Currently, there is not a way to download a list of all the participants who joined the
Space. I can share additional metrics from my side, though # of people who opted-in for a reminder is
also not currently available.
Amplification. Working on the Twitter account amplification, and we will be flagging for the team on
additional discovery points.
Don't hesitate to let me know if you have any additional questions.
